entities.name: Query MurE ligase
observations: 508 aa protein; estimated molecular mass 54.62 kDa and theoretical pI 6.32.
Sequence contains Mur_ligase (PF01225), Mur_ligase_M (PF08245), and Mur_ligase_C (PF02875) domains.
Shows 44.8–46.1% identity over 92.7–97.4% query coverage to reviewed MurE homologs.
Most likely a cytosolic UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate--2,6-diaminopimelate ligase (MurE), EC 6.3.2.13.
Predicted reaction adds meso-diaminopimelate to UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu using ATP, producing UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-γ-D-Glu-meso-DAP, ADP, and phosphate.
Likely requires Mg2+ and participates in bacterial peptidoglycan biosynthesis, cell division, and cell-shape maintenance.
Functional assignment is supported by homology and domain architecture; exact substrate specificity is inferred rather than experimentally demonstrated for this sequence.
